messages:
maria: dropped a new compact mock for the spend page, trying a left-rail breakdown vs stacked card. proto: https://redwood.design/p/compact-rail :eyes:
aj: quick read. left-rail is great for scanning across many projects, stacked card better for narrow screens. need responsive rule.
sam: big +1 on responsive behavior. also: switching scope (org <-> project) currently resets token denom to USD. can we persist denom per user or at least per session? it breaks token-first workflows. :thinking_face:
kyle: a11y items: legend swatches in dark mode have ~3.7:1 contrast. bump background to token-neutral-300. scope toggle needs an explicit aria-label; screen readers announce "button" only now.
olivia: invoice CTA placement: prefer contextual labeling: "Download project invoice" when project scoped; "Download org invoice" when org scoped. non-admins should see disabled CTA with tooltip that says "You need billing access to download invoices."
nina: layout nit: if left-rail is used, make breakdown sticky but collapse on scroll for mobile. store collapse state in localStorage so it remembers per-user.
billing-bot: FYI: invoices API returns 404 for months not finalized and for non-billing-admins. map to friendly states: "Invoice not available yet" or "Access restricted". don't surface raw 404.
aj: chart behavior: add a tiny inline control to switch denom between tokens and USD. prefer client-side transform using cached rate for the selected range to avoid extra backend calls. keyboard focus order should include that control.
maria: action list: 1) a11y contrast + aria fixes (kyle) 2) persist token denom per-user/session (sam) 3) contextual invoice CTA + disabled tooltip (olivia) 4) left-rail sticky on desktop, collapsible on mobile with persisted state (nina + aj) 5) client-side denom toggle (maria) 6) map invoice 404 to friendly copy (aj + billing-bot). I'll push an updated prototype by EOD for quick testing. :thumbsup:
